verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence pack documents a JSON output mode for npm CLI commands such as install, ls, or search. The registry API's packument JSON (npm-docs-18) is a separate HTTP endpoint, not machine-readable output from core CLI commands, and generic `--key val` config switches do not show any JSON output option.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get machine-readable (JSON) output from core commands so an agent can parse results instead of scraping text
